argument:
The bull correctly distinguishes strong demand from governance risk, but delivered growth does not establish an attractive entry price. Same-basis valuation remains unavailable, while management guides gross margin down from 74.8% to 71–72%; the cause and durability of that compression remain unresolved.

Oversold conditions cannot supply the missing confirmation: the technical desk reports price 23.64% below SMA200, substantial negative MACD and 1.69-times volume on a decline. Leadership uncertainty persists despite the revenue beat. The conditional upside scenario is plausible, but its conditions have not been observed.
key_points: Latest margin guidance weakens the earnings-quality margin
Oversold tape remains a confirmed decline
rebuttal_to_previous: Strong delivered demand is conceded; the bull has not shown that governance uncertainty, guided margin compression or the active decline are already adequately priced.
